title: Отделить PHP core от testkit/reference и закрыть API drift
summary: Привести Composer autoload, namespaces, archive contents и PHP docs/tests к P7.1 contract: production dependency получает только core, а test doubles/reference slice доступны только development root.
why: `php/composer.json` помещает `AgenTools\\Reference\\` в production `autoload`, а `InMemory*`/`FixedClock` лежат в `src`; optimized consumer autoload therefore cannot distinguish production contract from examples/testkit. `RAG:—`.

include: Stable/advanced PHP namespace allowlist; Composer production vs `autoload-dev`; `AgenTools\\TestKit\\` and `AgenTools\\Reference\\` placement; in-memory/fixed/reference implementations; production dependency graph; package archive exclusions; `API.md` and migration examples; actual-vs-target manifest and behavioural consumer tests.
exclude: Changing safe confirmation, replay, lease, EventStore or semantic behavior; adding framework adapters; designing production databases; Packagist metadata/upload; deleting a proved stable symbol without authorized compatibility path; unrelated source layout cleanup.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Production `autoload` contains no `AgenTools\\Reference\\` or testkit mapping; dev-only mappings are root-only and archive-excluded. Process-local/in-memory/fixed implementations move to the testkit tier or remain only through an explicitly documented compatibility shim allowed by the target contract; production services never instantiate them by default. `src` has no dependency on testkit/reference. Stable FQNs and signatures remain exact; candidate accidental names may move only with recorded disposition/migration. `composer.lock` changes only if manifest resolution requires it and no new runtime package is introduced.
guidance: Preserve behavior while changing ownership. Use namespaces/Composer mappings rather than runtime environment switches. Keep conformance/reference entrypoints runnable from the repository development root, but prove that `composer install --no-dev --classmap-authoritative` in a clean consumer cannot autoload testkit/reference. Generated actual manifest comes from `tools/package_surface.py`; never hand-edit it to match source.

result.notes:
PHP production autoload is AgenTools\\ → src/ only; TestKit/Reference are autoload-dev + archive-excluded. EventStoreSupport extracted so PdoPostgresEventStore does not instantiate InMemory. composer test 237, phpstan OK, no-dev probe absents TestKit/Reference. Archive 155 files, 145 src, no testkit/reference/tests/conformance.
